chart.title: Cumulative net
chart.infoText: The line adds up the month’s net day by day — income minus expenses, from confirmed transactions only — so it can fall as well as rise, and it ends on exactly the "Net This Month" figure above it. The green mark on the axis is the height of the monthly income goal set on the "Goals" screen, for reference only; the exact goal tracking is the number in the heading, and it is measured on income. The dot marks today.
